verdicts.command: Probe built from head and from base (engine/cmd/zzprobehook in scratch copies probe2h and probe2b). It runs Output(ctx 10s, PATH=, /bin/sh -c "x=$(/bin/sleep 41.3 & echo $! > pidfile; wait)"). On head the runner is execrunner.New().WithProcessGroup(); on base it is execrunner.New(). Each was started with setsid and then got either kill -KILL <hook pid> or kill -KILL -- -<hook pgid>. After 0.5s: ps -o stat=,pgid=,args= -p <grandchild>
verdicts.output: head kill-pid: hook pgid=3807792, grandchild pgid=3807799 -> 'S 3807799 /bin/sleep 41.3' (alive). head kill-group: hook pgid=3807821, grandchild pgid=3807828 -> 'S 3807828 /bin/sleep 41.3' (alive). base kill-pid: grandchild pgid=3807850 (the hook's own group) -> alive. base kill-group: -> GONE. On head, a signal sent to the hook's process group does not reach the script's group, which outlives the hook. A SIGKILL to the hook pid alone leaves the grandchild alive on both head and base. The surviving grandchildren were then killed by their PIDs.

verdicts.command: rg -n 'every process it started' README.md CHANGELOG.md engine/... (head and base). Then a head probe with ctx 200ms and WithProcessGroup(), body "x=$(/usr/bin/setsid /bin/sleep 41.3 & echo $! > pidfile; wait)", timed with date, then ps -p <grandchild> 1s after return
verdicts.output: head: README.md:1582 and CHANGELOG.md:30 say 'on Unix stopped at 2 seconds with every process it started'. engine/cmd/review_stop_hook_docs_test.go:173 pins 'with every process it started'. Probe: 'returned: context deadline exceeded (signal: killed)', 'call took 2.208035276s', and 1s after return 'Ss 3809182 /bin/sleep 41.3' (alive, in its own session). The descendant that called setsid escaped the group kill and held the call for about killGrace. base: rg found no 'every process it started' (printed base-no-phrase).

verdicts.output: architecture_short_name_test.go:47 walks only []string{"review", "cmd"}, and line 49 skips _test.go. The lines 17-18 comment concedes the `n := 12` case, and line 78 pins it to 0 hits. With [:12] in execrunner/: '--- PASS: TestTheShortNameOfAnObjectIsWrittenOnce', 'ok'. With the same file in review/: 'review/zz_probe_short.go:3:43: a slice cut at the literal 12: write the short name of an object once, as review.ShortName', '--- FAIL'. Base has no architecture_short_name_test.go, so no check ran there.

verdicts.command: Built cmd/zzenotdir from head and from base. It calls evidencesh.New(execrunner.New(), Options{Script: os.Args[1], Environ: PATH}).Classified(root, ["abc123def456-1.json"]). Ran it with <scratch>/notadir/evidence.sh, where notadir is a regular file, and as a control with <scratch>/missingdir/evidence.sh
verdicts.output: head ENOTDIR: 'error: sh .../notadir/evidence.sh reviewed-each exited 2: sh: 0: cannot open .../notadir/evidence.sh: No such file'. head control (missing dir): 'error: the evidence store is not deployed: nothing is at .../missingdir/evidence.sh (labdrian apply deploys it to Claude Code): stat ...: no such file or directory'. Base printed the same exited-2 line for both paths, because it has no os.Stat check (rg printed base-no-stat). Note: the head package doc at evidencesh.go:12-13 says 'any other error of the stat goes on to the run'.
